name: FedEx/India Post Narcotic Scam
templates: Your parcel containing illegal items has been intercepted by Mumbai Customs.
CBI has issued a warrant against your Aadhar number due to drug trafficking.
Press 1 to speak with the narcotics department immediately.

name: Electricity Disconnection Scam
templates: Dear Consumer, your electricity will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM.
Electricity bill not updated. Call electricity officer at 98xxxxxxx.
Pay your previous month bill to avoid blackout.

name: E-Challan Fake Link
templates: Digital Traffic Challan: Your vehicle violated traffic rules. Pay fine within 2 hours.
Court summons is issued for unpaid challan. Check status at bit.ly/fake-challan.

name: Arrest/Family Emergency Scam
templates: Your son/relative is in police custody for a serious crime.
Major accident occurred. Need immediate funds for surgery at city hospital.
Police officer on line needs ₹50,000 for bail processing.
